summary.text: Dennis Lenz is a Republican state senator who represents Montana State Senate District 25, has served in the Senate since 2023 after earlier terms in the Montana House, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as fire captain and farmer.

paragraphs.text: Dennis Lenz served in the Montana House of Representatives from 2013 to 2015 (District 50) and from 2017 to 2023 (District 53) before moving to the State Senate.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as fire captain and farmer.
In the 2025-2026 session Lenz chaired the Public Health, Welfare and Safety Committee and was a member of the Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation and Finance and Claims committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Julie Hippler in the general election.
